narrative.details: We must find who the supplier is. I noticed Apothecary Katrina with a bottle of the perfume tucked in her pack. She told me that she purchased it from Norman, the innkeeper.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Innkeeper Norman in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah yes, I just recently received stock of the perfume and cologne. I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves - seems like no one can get enough of it.

If you ask me, I don't see what the big deal is.
